label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, when the policy leans toward a1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.5% of mass; never at D2, weakly at GO) and only when the reward input is 0, meaning the previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 99.6% of mass; it essentially never fires after a reward). Inside that context it is gated by the agent leaning toward a1: the model choice logit at the step is strongly positive (the 2.78 to 8.07 bin holds 92% of mass), and the upcoming action is a1 for 91% of mass. The good state is S1 for 80% of mass. The predicate uses only the observed reward input and the model own policy output (no future variables). On dev it gives P 0.69, R 0.75, F1 0.72, mass recall 0.89. Magnitude (checked): bigger after two unrewarded trials in a row (adding tv(prev_reward,-1)==0 raises precision to 0.88 and covers 64% of the top quartile), and it builds up over runs of r0 trials and later in the episode. Misses are mostly weak activations at GO or at D1 when the a1 lean is small. False positives are D1 r0 steps after one isolated loss, where it stays below threshold. Does NOT fire at D2, after rewarded trials, or when the policy favours a2.
